predecessors.name: Kingdom of Asturias
predecessors.text: García I's share of 910: León, without Fruela's Asturias but with the eastern marches around Burgos

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Galicia
predecessors.text: Galicia, ruled by Ordoño from 910 and joined to León on García I's death in 914

successors.name: Kingdom of Castile
successors.text: León, León's Extremadura and Galicia, united with Castile for good

ledger.x: 910: García I makes León a kingdom.
914: Ordoño II unites León and Galicia.
924: Asturias joins León.
931: the County of Castile splits off.
937: the caliph's campaign in León.
939: Simancas moves the frontier to the Tormes.
951: peace with the caliph.
990: the Mondego and the Beira fall away.
1046: Ferdinand I's two kingdoms are drawn as one.
1065: Ferdinand I's kingdom is divided and León goes to Alfonso.
1072: Sancho II defeats Alfonso at Golpejera.
1126: Alfonso VII is crowned in León.
1139: the Portuguese lands separate.
1139: León is drawn inside the Castile row again.
1157: Alfonso VII's death splits Castile and León.
1188: Extremadura is added to León's shape.
1202: the Extremaduran increment is gone.
1230: Alfonso IX takes Mérida and Badajoz.
1230: León is permanently united with Castile.
1230: the Kingdom of León ends in the union.

wars.name: Leonese wars of Abd al-Rahman III (Simancas)
wars.outcome: Caliph's army crushed at Simancas in 939; the Leonese border moves from the Duero to the Tormes; peace in 951.

wars.name: Almanzor's campaigns against León
wars.outcome: Raids on Salamanca, Cuéllar, Zamora (September 981) and 'Portuguese lands, probably Viseu'; no land is shown taken on the page; the 988 sack of León and the 997 sack of Santiago are not on a page read here.

wars.name: Battle of Tamarón and Ferdinand I's conquest of León
wars.outcome: Ferdinand I, count of Castile, 'defeated and killed his suzerain at the Battle of Tamarón on 4 September 1037' and was crowned king in León on 22 June 1038: Castile and León under one king, still two kingdoms.

wars.name: War of the sons of Ferdinand I (Sancho II against Alfonso VI and García)
wars.outcome: Sancho II invaded Galicia in 1071, defeated Alfonso VI at Golpejera on 12 January 1072 and was murdered at the siege of Zamora; Alfonso VI took back León and took Castile and Galicia.

wars.name: Alfonso IX's wars with Castile (treaties of 1205, 1207 and 1209)
wars.outcome: 'treaties made in 1205, 1207, and 1209 each forced him to concede further territories and rights'; 'In July 1188 his cousin Alfonso VIII of Castile required the younger Alfonso to recognize the elder as overlord'.

wars.name: Alfonso IX's Extremadura campaigns (Cáceres 1218, Mérida and Badajoz 1230)
wars.outcome: The 1218 crusade on Cáceres failed ('poor weather doomed it'); Mérida and Badajoz were captured in 1230.

certainty.note: Frontiers with the caliphate, the taifas, Castile and Navarre are marches; the pages opened give no surveyed line.
